body:
An independent check of this terminology pass for preservation of the mathematics is in #481 (task #479).

It found no changed statement, constant or exponent, and label, `\eqref` and `\cite` sets are preserved. It requests three notation fixes:
- S1: new symbol overloads (`\omega` twice, `\mathcal B`, `\mathcal N`);
- S2: missing symbolic-index entries;
- S3: the dilation is still written `D_L` in reference-cone.tex and `\mathscr V_L` in primary-calibration-producer.tex.

It also lists editorial items: leftover terms, duplicated words, and "decompositiones".

Prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission.
